lines.zh: 沿着洞穴壁滑翔，翅膀轻拍。
lines.en: Swoop along the cave wall, wings fluttering.
Wings scrape, producing a ssssh sound.
Body crawls lightly.
Leaps lightly to avoid sight.
Taps the ground with antennae.
Wings beat against the cave wall.
Faster through the cave.
I watch first, then swoop.
Body moves quickly.
Wings flapping, flying towards the light.
I walk sideways along the cave wall.

lines.zh: 六条腿轮流落下，没有声音。
lines.en: Six legs fall in turn without a sound.
I creep across the stone ceiling.
My wing cases open, and I slide into the dark.

lines.zh: 我在你身后的钟乳石间移动。
lines.en: I move among the stalactites behind you.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但你追不上。
lines.en: I am not fast, yet you cannot catch me.
Lies still against the wall.
Stares into the depths of the cave.
Body slowly contorts.
Wiggles slightly, adjusting position.
Antennae explore the surroundings.
Wings vibrate gently.
Silently rests.
Body rises and falls slowly.
Taps the cave rock.
Occasionally makes a soft noise.
I hang from the ceiling, waiting for you to turn.
I hold my breath and stay perfectly still.
Eyes turn to the player.
Stares at the player.
Detects player, starts moving.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里盯着你的后颈。
lines.en: I stare at your neck from the rock crack.
Turns to the player, preparing to chase.

lines.zh: 你那点目光，我盯了很久了。
lines.en: I've watched that little gaze of yours for a while.
I wait in the dark for your back to turn.
Glares at the player, unrelenting.

lines.zh: 我先在洞里看你一会儿。
lines.en: I'll watch you from the cave a while.

lines.zh: 观察玩家的每一个动作。
lines.en: Observes every player move.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才开始动。
lines.en: I watched you a long while before I moved.
A membrane on my back split...
My belly plate got pried open...
Antennae injured...
Leg broken, and I can still crawl.

lines.zh: 我会躲起来，等你忘记我。
lines.en: I'll hide until you forget me.
Wings damaged...
Abdomen damaged...
My antenna hit the cave wall.
I slip into a crack and vanish.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我一千点血耗得起。
lines.en: This scratch is nothing against a thousand health.
Buzzing to tempt you closer.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我蠢蠢欲动。
lines.en: Your shadow tempts me.
Come closer, for your treat.
Antennae touch, a kiss of temptation.
Delicious right here.
Your scent tempts me.
Temptation, so simple.
Come closer, my prey.
Savor this moment's sweetness.
Come near, for the treat.
Collides suddenly into you.
Can't avoid the collision.
Collides to find an opening.
Collides, searching for gaps.
Collides in search of response.
Collides to test your reactions.
Collides for a battle chance.
Collides to fight.
Collides to find your weakness.
Collides to ignite the fight instinct.
Sings for a mate.

lines.zh: 释放求偶信号，寻找配偶。
lines.en: Releases mating signal.
Whispers to find a mate.
Low hum for a mate.
Whispers to find a mate.
Sings for a mate.
Whispers to find a mate.
Whispers to find a mate.
Whispers to find a mate.
Somewhere deep in the cave, my kind is calling.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，但我知道你在。
lines.en: You can't see me, but I know you're there.

lines.zh: 躲在这里，没人能找到我。
lines.en: Hide here, no one will find me.

lines.zh: 虫子的家，藏着无尽的秘密。
lines.en: Insects have secrets hidden in their homes.

lines.zh: 我藏在阴影中，等待时机。
lines.en: I hide in the shadows, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，才是我的领地。
lines.en: The caves are where I belong.
Move, and I vanish.
This is my home, my rules.

lines.zh: 躲藏不是我的唯一技能。
lines.en: Hiding isn't my only skill.

lines.zh: 洞穴尽头，才是真正的开始。
lines.en: The end of the cave is just the beginning.
Try to catch me, you'll never catch me.

lines.zh: 猎物的味道，让我心跳加速。
lines.en: The scent of prey makes my heart race.

lines.zh: 你的动作，暴露了你的位置。
lines.en: Your movements give you away.
This is where your journey ends.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，都在我的计算之中。
lines.en: Every move you make is calculated.

lines.zh: 你越是挣扎，我就越兴奋。
lines.en: The more you struggle, the more excited I get.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧，让我更接近胜利。
lines.en: Your fear makes me closer to victory.

lines.zh: 你转身时，我已经贴上来。
lines.en: When you turn, I'm already close.

lines.zh: 猎物的味道，越来越近了。
lines.en: The scent of prey is getting closer.

lines.zh: 你动弹不得，只能任我宰割。
lines.en: You're helpless, at my mercy.

lines.zh: 这是我的狩猎，我主宰一切。
lines.en: This is my hunt, I control everything.
You finally looked this way.

lines.zh: 我数完你的呼吸，开始追。
lines.en: I finished counting your breaths and began the chase.
Come closer and you'll see me.
My sight cannot be avoided.
I've locked onto your position.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀，即将带你飞翔。
lines.en: My wings will take you flying.
You can't escape my net.

lines.zh: 猎物，即将成为我的晚餐。
lines.en: Prey, about to be my dinner.

lines.zh: 我的触须，将引导你走向死亡。
lines.en: My触须 will lead you to death.

lines.zh: 我已经准备好，要享用你了。
lines.en: I'm ready to feast on you.

lines.zh: 我的毒液，将终结你的一切。
lines.en: My poison will end it all.

lines.zh: 我将用我的尖刺，刺穿你的防线。
lines.en: I'll pierce your defenses with my spikes.
You ran into a dead end; I am in no hurry.
I come out of a different mouth of the cave.
I vanish, leaving only footsteps.

lines.zh: 你听见的，只有自己的心跳。
lines.en: All you hear is your own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的嗡鸣，从黑暗中扑来。
lines.en: Rumbles with a low buzz, swooping out of the dark.

lines.zh: 挥动翅膀，向你发起冲击。
lines.en: Flaps its wings and charges at you.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的触角攻击你的腿部。
lines.en: Stabs you in the leg with its hard antennae.

lines.zh: 靠近时嘶嘶作响，准备战斗。
lines.en: Hisses when approaching, ready to fight.

lines.zh: 挥动翅膀，试图击中你的头部。
lines.en: Swings its wings to hit your head.

lines.zh: 快速挥动触角，试图缠住你。
lines.en: Swiftly swings its antennae to entangle you.

lines.zh: 用大颚夹住你，释放致命毒素。
lines.en: Clamps you with its large jaws, releasing deadly venom.

lines.zh: 用尖刺攻击你，尽量造成伤害。
lines.en: Attacks with its spines, trying to inflict damage.

lines.zh: 从阴影中跃出，进行致命一击。
lines.en: Leap from the shadows for the fatal strike.

lines.zh: 用毒液覆盖的触角攻击你。
lines.en: Attacks with venom-coated antennae.

lines.zh: 躲在洞穴深处，静候佳音。
lines.en: Hides in the depths of the cave, waiting.

lines.zh: 在洞穴中孵化，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Hatches in the cave, seeking prey.
Slowly hatches from the egg.

lines.zh: 从卵中破壳而出，寻找食物。
lines.en: Breaks out of the egg to seek food.
Hatches in the crevices of the cave.

lines.zh: 在岩壁上孵化，准备觅食。
lines.en: Hatches on the rock wall, ready to forage.

lines.zh: 孵化于黑暗洞穴的阴影中。
lines.en: Hatches in the shadows of the dark cave.

lines.zh: 从岩石缝隙中孵化，寻找食物。
lines.en: Hatches from rock crevices, searching for food.

lines.zh: 在洞穴深处孵化，悄然出现。
lines.en: Hatches deep in the cave, appearing quietly.

lines.zh: 孵化于洞穴中，静待机会。
lines.en: Hatches in the cave, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 洞穴暗处，一千零二十四点血。
lines.en: In the dark of the cave, one thousand and twenty-four health.

lines.zh: 你走进洞穴时，我已经在那里。
lines.en: When you entered the cave, I was already there.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了...，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured wings — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 腹部受伤了...，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Abdomen injured — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 触角受伤了...，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Antennae injured — and the drown makes it worse.
The blast slams me against the cave wall...
An arrow lodges in my shoulder...
Those spells gnaw at my shell...

lines.zh: 腿部受伤了...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Leg injured — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷顺着洞壁打在我身上...
lines.en: Lightning runs down the cave wall into me...

lines.zh: 虚空把我拖下去，还看得见你。
lines.en: The void drags me down; I can still see you.
